items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: About a year-and-a-half I played with Sarah Vaughan.

ctx.x: You spent a fair amount of time on a gig with Sarah Vaughan as well.
About a year-and-a-half I played with Sarah Vaughan. That was another glorious moment.
I can imagine. And I imagine you must have learned every tune in the book.
